2607.08193.title: Open-ended Multi-agent Autocurricula via Visual Inspection of Policies with Multi-modal LLMs
2607.08193.paper_summary: Open-ended curricula in Reinforcement Learning (RL) aim to train generally-capable agents by identifying tasks that facilitate learning increasingly complex skills. A major challenge when designing such curricula is assessing task difficulty relative to the agent's current learning progress. While previous work has explored using scalar task scores or textual summaries of the agent's behavior, here we study a different approach: directly inspecting policy behavior via recorded episode videos. We introduce a simple yet effective instantiation of this approach which leverages a Video Language Model (VLM) to both process these videos and provide curriculum recommendations, which we call Visual Inspection of Policies (VIP). Since videos can naturally contain any number of controllable agents, we empirically study VIP on the StarCraft Multi-Agent Challenge (SMAC). We show that even with a lightweight and openly accessible VLM (VideoLLaMa2-7B), VIP can use policy videos to generate more effective curricula than both its text-only ablation and methods that rely on scalar task scores.
2607.08193.paper_summary_zh: 開放式課程在強化學習（RL）中旨在通過識別促進學習日益複雜技能的任務來訓練一般能力的代理。設計這類課程的一個主要挑戰是評估任務難度相對於代理當前的學習進度。雖然之前的研究探討了使用標量任務分數或代理行為的文本摘要，但在這裡我們研究了一種不同的方法：通過錄製的劇集視頻直接檢查策略行為。我們介紹了一種簡單而有效的這種方法的具體實現，利用視頻語言模型（VLM）來處理這些視頻並提供課程建議，我們稱之為策略的視覺檢查（VIP）。由於視頻自然可以包含任意數量的可控代理，我們在星際爭霸多代理挑戰（SMAC）上實證研究了VIP。我們顯示，即使使用輕量級且公開可訪問的VLM（VideoLLaMa2-7B），VIP也能利用策略視頻生成比其僅文本消融和依賴標量任務分數的方法更有效的課程。
